---

## Soft Brand / Collection Hotels: What Mexican Hotel Owners Should Know

When a hotel owner in Mexico wants **brand affiliation** but needs to **preserve their property's individuality**, the answer lies in what the industry calls **"soft brands"** or **"collection brands."**

### What Is a Soft Brand?


A soft brand is an affiliation between an independent hotel and a hotel chain that allows independent hotels to retain their identities while benefiting from a chain's marketing and distribution resources, including access to global loyalty programs, volume discounts on procurement, better terms with OTAs, and other economies of scale.



Experts call soft brands "the best of both worlds: individuality plus the commercial engine of a major brand."
 
Rather than creating a uniform guest experience, they seek to preserve the identity of each property. Hotels joining collections such as Autograph Collection, Curio Collection, or Vignette Collection typically retain their own name, history, and market positioning.


---

### The Main Soft Brand Collections Relevant to Mexico

#### 🏨 **Marriott International**

Marriott played a pivotal role in expanding the soft brand concept through its **Autograph Collection**, launched in 2010. Building on this success, Marriott expanded its offerings through the acquisition of Starwood Hotels and Resorts, adding other soft brands like **The Luxury Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, and **Design Hotels**.


A real-world Mexico example: 
Samuel Leizorek, managing partner of **Las Alcobas Mexico City**, which joined the **Luxury Collection**, says being part of a soft brand requires the dedication of a hands-on owner: "Owners who might want this have to be highly involved in the day-to-day management of a property…people who retain the soul of an innkeeper and manage a property with great attention to details."


#### 🏨 **Hilton**

Hilton offers soft brands including the **Curio Collection** and **LXR Hotels & Resorts**.
 The Curio Collection is particularly popular in upscale and upper-upscale markets and has a strong presence in Latin America.

#### 🏨 **Hyatt**

The **Unbound Collection by Hyatt** is a portfolio of upper-upscale and luxury properties ranging from historic urban gems to revitalizing retreats and modern marvels. The philosophy behind the brand is to attract owners and developers who want their properties to maintain a distinct character and brand name, but gain the power of Hyatt's robust distribution, operational, and marketing resources.
 Hyatt also offers **JdV by Hyatt** and the **Unscripted** brand for independent-spirited properties.

#### 🏨 **IHG (InterContinental Hotels Group)**

IHG offers the **Vignette Collection**, aimed at luxury independent hotels.
 
The Vignette Collection is joined by other conversion-friendly brands such as **Voco** and the newly launched **Noted Collection**.


#### 🏨 **Accor**

Accor offers **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery**, and the **Handwritten Collection** — showing that even major players recognize the need for soft brands at multiple price points.


#### 🏨 **Wyndham**

Wyndham has two soft brands: the **Registry Collection** in the luxury space, and **Trademark by Wyndham** in the upper midscale/upscale space.


#### 🏨 **Choice Hotels**

The **Ascend Collection**, an upscale soft brand of Choice Hotels International and the first and largest soft brand in the upscale segment, has surpassed its 500th property milestone, reflecting the brand's commitment to delivering guests one-of-a-kind, locally inspired stays that celebrate the individuality of each destination.


---

### Voluntary Chains / Consortia (Non-Corporate Alternatives)

Beyond corporate soft brands, some owners prefer **voluntary chains or consortia**, which tend to offer even more freedom:


There are two leading player types in the soft brand market — voluntary chains such as **Leading Hotels of the World** and **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, and corporate soft brand collections that traditional brands have been launching in recent years.


- 
The **Leading Hotels of the World** consortium was founded in 1928, **Preferred Hotels & Resorts** was established in 1968, and **Small Luxury Hotels of the World** came onto the scene in 1989.

- 
**Relais & Châteaux** has always had the distinction of being food-first and food-forward, and admission to it is highly selective.

- 
The **Global Hotel Alliance (GHA)** brings together a collection of 50 independent hotel brands and nearly 1,000 properties worldwide.



A consortium is a group of independent hotels joined together to improve certain aspects of operation; hotels benefit from joined resources and are **not** required to follow brand standards.


---

### Key Takeaway for Mexican Owners


The upper upscale and upscale conversion space is increasingly crowded, and the pitch to owners is essentially the same everywhere: "Keep your name, get our distribution."



Properties affiliated with a soft brand "retain independence in branding and operating decisions as well as regional, cultural, and architectural distinctions that give them local charm." Hotel owners get access to the brand's benefits but maintain individuality.


The most commonly considered options for Mexican hotel owners, in summary, are:

| Brand Group | Soft Brand Collections |
|---|---|
| **Marriott** | Autograph Collection, Luxury Collection, Tribute Portfolio, Design Hotels |
| **Hilton** | Curio Collection, LXR Hotels & Resorts, Tapestry Collection |
| **Hyatt** | Unbound Collection, JdV by Hyatt, Unscripted |
| **IHG** | Vignette Collection, Voco, Noted Collection |
| **Accor** | Emblems Collection, MGallery, Handwritten Collection |
| **Wyndham** | Registry Collection, Trademark by Wyndham |
| **Choice Hotels** | Ascend Collection |
| **Consortia** | Leading Hotels of the World, Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Small Luxury Hotels, Relais & Châteaux, GHA |

---

## Soft Brand / Collection Hotels: What Mexican Hotel Owners Should Know

When a hotel owner in Mexico wants **brand affiliation** but needs to **preserve their property's individuality**, the answer lies in what the industry calls **"soft brands"** or **"collection brands."**

### What Is a Soft Brand?


A soft brand is an affiliation between an independent hotel and a hotel chain that allows independent hotels to retain their identities while benefiting from a chain's marketing and distribution resources, including access to global loyalty programs, volume discounts on procurement, better terms with OTAs, and other economies of scale.



Experts call soft brands "the best of both worlds: individuality plus the commercial engine of a major brand."
 
Rather than creating a uniform guest experience, they seek to preserve the identity of each property. Hotels joining collections such as Autograph Collection, Curio Collection, or Vignette Collection typically retain their own name, history, and market positioning.


---

### The Main Soft Brand Collections Relevant to Mexico

#### 🏨 **Marriott International**

Marriott played a pivotal role in expanding the soft brand concept through its **Autograph Collection**, launched in 2010. Building on this success, Marriott expanded its offerings through the acquisition of Starwood Hotels and Resorts, adding other soft brands like **The Luxury Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, and **Design Hotels**.


A real-world Mexico example: 
Samuel Leizorek, managing partner of **Las Alcobas Mexico City**, which joined the **Luxury Collection**, says being part of a soft brand requires the dedication of a hands-on owner: "Owners who might want this have to be highly involved in the day-to-day management of a property…people who retain the soul of an innkeeper and manage a property with great attention to details."


#### 🏨 **Hilton**

Hilton offers soft brands including the **Curio Collection** and **LXR Hotels & Resorts**.
 The Curio Collection is particularly popular in upscale and upper-upscale markets and has a strong presence in Latin America.

#### 🏨 **Hyatt**

The **Unbound Collection by Hyatt** is a portfolio of upper-upscale and luxury properties ranging from historic urban gems to revitalizing retreats and modern marvels. The philosophy behind the brand is to attract owners and developers who want their properties to maintain a distinct character and brand name, but gain the power of Hyatt's robust distribution, operational, and marketing resources.
 Hyatt also offers **JdV by Hyatt** and the **Unscripted** brand for independent-spirited properties.

#### 🏨 **IHG (InterContinental Hotels Group)**

IHG offers the **Vignette Collection**, aimed at luxury independent hotels.
 
The Vignette Collection is joined by other conversion-friendly brands such as **Voco** and the newly launched **Noted Collection**.


#### 🏨 **Accor**

Accor offers **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery**, and the **Handwritten Collection** — showing that even major players recognize the need for soft brands at multiple price points.


#### 🏨 **Wyndham**

Wyndham has two soft brands: the **Registry Collection** in the luxury space, and **Trademark by Wyndham** in the upper midscale/upscale space.


#### 🏨 **Choice Hotels**

The **Ascend Collection**, an upscale soft brand of Choice Hotels International and the first and largest soft brand in the upscale segment, has surpassed its 500th property milestone, reflecting the brand's commitment to delivering guests one-of-a-kind, locally inspired stays that celebrate the individuality of each destination.


---

### Voluntary Chains / Consortia (Non-Corporate Alternatives)

Beyond corporate soft brands, some owners prefer **voluntary chains or consortia**, which tend to offer even more freedom:


There are two leading player types in the soft brand market — voluntary chains such as **Leading Hotels of the World** and **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, and corporate soft brand collections that traditional brands have been launching in recent years.


- 
The **Leading Hotels of the World** consortium was founded in 1928, **Preferred Hotels & Resorts** was established in 1968, and **Small Luxury Hotels of the World** came onto the scene in 1989.

- 
**Relais & Châteaux** has always had the distinction of being food-first and food-forward, and admission to it is highly selective.

- 
The **Global Hotel Alliance (GHA)** brings together a collection of 50 independent hotel brands and nearly 1,000 properties worldwide.



A consortium is a group of independent hotels joined together to improve certain aspects of operation; hotels benefit from joined resources and are **not** required to follow brand standards.


---

### Key Takeaway for Mexican Owners


The upper upscale and upscale conversion space is increasingly crowded, and the pitch to owners is essentially the same everywhere: "Keep your name, get our distribution."



Properties affiliated with a soft brand "retain independence in branding and operating decisions as well as regional, cultural, and architectural distinctions that give them local charm." Hotel owners get access to the brand's benefits but maintain individuality.


The most commonly considered options for Mexican hotel owners, in summary, are:
